name: cost-capped-translation
description: Detect the input language, branch on whether translation is needed, then translate with a cost-capped Model call. Demonstrates the Branch node + the Transform node (a deterministic no-LLM pass) + per-node max_cost_usd. A translation workflow is a classic per-call cost-sensitivity case — the receipt shows each step's token_delta.

nodes.prompt: Detect the ISO 639-1 language code of this text. Respond with only the 2-letter code. Text: {{input.text}}
Translate the following text to English, preserving meaning + tone. Text: {{input.text}}
